subject: Exports failing on all reports

subject: Exports failing a third time this week
body: Exports down again - third time this week. I know you always get these fixed fast, but the frequency itself is becoming the issue.

subject: API integration down

subject: Connector sync stopped
body: Our main data connector has stopped syncing as of this morning - dashboards are showing yesterday's numbers. Please take a look.

subject: Connector down again, three days later

subject: Alerts down heading into year-end
body: Alerts have gone quiet again, right as we head into year-end reporting - not great timing. Appreciate you're usually fast on these, hoping for the same now.

subject: API rate limits ahead of year-end close
body: As we head into year-end reporting, I wanted to check what our current API rate limits are under the Professional plan. We're planning to pull larger batches of historical data for a consolidation exercise in January and want to make sure we don't hit throttling mid-run. Could you confirm the request-per-minute ceiling and whether it's possible to request a temporary increase for the last week of December? Happy to provide more detail on the specific endpoints we'd be using. Thanks, Kristina

subject: Recurring API timeouts on scheduled pulls
body: We're seeing intermittent timeout errors on our scheduled API pulls again — similar rate-limit territory to what Kristina raised back in December, though this time it's timing out rather than throttling outright. It's happening roughly two to three times a week, usually on the larger endpoint calls, and we're having to re-run manually when it does. Could someone check whether the rate-limit increase from December is still in place? Log excerpts from the last two failures are attached. Regards, Liisa Johansson, Head of Operations

subject: Connector mapping issue after source system update
body: Our accounting system had a scheduled update last week and since then the data connector has been mapping two of the cost-centre fields incorrectly, which is throwing off the departmental breakdowns. Could someone take a look at the field mapping for our connector? Separately, and unrelated to this specific issue, as part of next year's tooling review we've been asked to take a look at Dashlume alongside our renewal, so if there's anything worth knowing about the roadmap for connector reliability, I'd welcome the context. Kristina

subject: Dashboard load times still slow on the operations view
body: The operations dashboard is still taking upwards of thirty seconds to load most mornings, which we first mentioned informally a while back. It's not broken exactly, just slow enough that a couple of the team have started pulling the numbers from the scheduled export instead of opening the live view. No particular urgency on our end since the workaround is holding up fine, but wanted it on record in case it's part of a wider pattern you're tracking. Liisa

subject: Scheduled exports not sending
body: The nightly export job to our SFTP folder has failed for the last three nights - no error in the log, just nothing arrives. Can someone check the scheduler on our account? This is blocking our morning reporting.

subject: API calls returning 500 since last week
body: Since last week our integration has been getting intermittent 500 errors from the reporting API, roughly one in five calls. Nothing changed on our end. Please look into this soon, it's affecting the finance dashboard refresh.

subject: API down again - same as March
body: The same problem as the API outage we reported back in March is back - intermittent 500s, integration failing. Second time this quarter. We need a permanent fix, not another patch.

subject: Report builder losing unsaved changes
body: Report builder crashed twice today and both times it discarded the edits without warning. One of my analysts lost two hours of work. This needs to be looked at properly, not just restarted.

subject: Escalating - API issues still unresolved since spring
body: We've now had three separate API incidents since the spring outage, plus the report builder crash in October that's still open. I'd like this escalated to someone who can give us a real status update and a fix timeline, not just a ticket number.

subject: Connector sync stuck - need this escalated again

subject: Report builder - chart export sizing
